heading: Development of markets for recovered materials
lead: The Secretary of Commerce shall within two years after September 1, 1979, take such actions as may be necessary to—

tree.text: identify the geographical location of existing or potential markets for recovered materials;
identify the economic and technical barriers to the use of recovered materials; and
encourage the development of new uses for recovered materials.

ancestors.heading: DUTIES OF SECRETARY OF COMMERCE IN RESOURCE AND RECOVERY
